input.storyText: Ravi, a college student, noticed that the old bridge in his village had cracked after the rains. He and the village head inspected it and Ravi suggested closing it immediately. He organised volunteers to guide people to the safer route and called the engineer. The repairs were done in a week and everyone thanked the village head and Ravi for acting early.

input.storyText: Arjun and his uncle found the footbridge damaged when the river rose. Arjun quickly informed the panchayat, put up warning signs with other youths and arranged boats for the villagers on the other bank. By evening all were across safely. He later helped plan a stronger bridge with the district office.
